panel.title: Live tracking

command.title: Remote commands
command.abortConfirm: The game stops right away on the room screen. This cannot be undone.

error.room_not_controllable: The room is offline or its screen is not connected: the command was not sent.
error.too_many_requests: Too many commands in progress for this room. Try again in a few seconds.
error.command_unknown: This command no longer exists or has already been answered.
error.command_id_conflict: This command was already sent with different content. Start again.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to control this room.
error.unauthorized: Your session has expired: sign in again.
error.api_unreachable: The server is unreachable: the command was not sent.
error.server_error: Server error: the command was not sent.

result.expired: The room did not answer in time: the command may not have been applied.

refusal.paused: The question cannot be skipped while the game is paused.
refusal.not_in_question: The question had already changed: nothing was skipped.

disabled.stream: Live tracking interrupted: commands come back with the connection.
disabled.offline: The room is offline: it cannot receive commands.
disabled.screen: The room screen is not on the game.
disabled.noGame: No game in progress on the room screen.
disabled.skipPaused: Resume the game to skip the question.
disabled.skipPhase: A question can only be skipped while it is running.
